description: List every hosted code and short link on the signed-in account, both fixed and editable. Each item includes an `editable` flag, ids, short URLs, and destinations. Despite the historic name, this is not limited to dynamic/editable codes. Use this to find an `id` before update_dynamic_qr, get_qr_analytics, or deactivate_code, or to answer "what codes do I have?" Do not use this for scan totals (use get_account_analytics or get_qr_analytics) or to create codes. No input parameters.
name: list_dynamic_qrs
title: List codes
